title: Identify the ID of the earliest-admitted patient (based on First Date) who
question: Identify the ID of the earliest-admitted patient (based on First Date) who has an abnormal Ig M level, is under 50 years old at the time of a laboratory test in 1984, and—depending on their sex—has a uric acid level outside the normal range.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T2."XCL_044" > 400
  AND T2."XCL_016" < 50
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_015") = '1984'
  AND (
    (T1."XCL_059" = 'M' AND T2."XCL_022" > 8.0)
    OR
    (T1."XCL_059" = 'F' AND T2."XCL_022" > 6.5)
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_062" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1."XCL_058"
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_001"
WHERE NOT T2."XCL_051" IN ('negative','0')
  AND T2."XCL_017" < 50
  AND T2."XCL_042" = 1984

    OR (T1."XCL_059" = 'F' AND (T3."XCL_003" < 2.5 OR T3."XCL_003" > 6.0)))
ORDER BY T1."XCL_060" ASC
LIMIT 1
